connector.name: Google Ads MCP by davidmosiah
connector.registryDescription: Unofficial Google Ads MCP for campaigns, keywords, budgets, and gated mutations.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package google-ads-mcp-unofficial. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the davidmosiah account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN
env.description: Google Ads API developer token from your Google Ads Manager account. Required.

env.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Google OAuth2 client secret. Prefer storing in ~/.google-ads-mcp/config.json via setup.

env.name: GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID
env.description: Manager (MCC) customer ID used as login-customer-id header, no dashes (e.g., 1234567890). Optional but required for multi-account access.

env.name: GOOGLE_ADS_REDIRECT_URI
env.description: OAuth redirect URI. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:3000/callback.

env.name: GOOGLE_ADS_TOKEN_PATH
env.description: Optional local path for OAuth tokens. Defaults to ~/.google-ads-mcp/tokens.json (0600).

env.name: GOOGLE_ADS_PRIVACY_MODE
env.description: Optional payload mode: summary, structured, or raw. Defaults to structured. raw returns full Google Ads API payloads.

env.name: GOOGLE_ADS_ALLOW_MUTATIONS
env.description: Set to true to enable write tools (pause/resume keywords/campaigns, set bids, set budgets). Default false (read-only). Agents changing real ad spend is high-stakes; review every change.

env.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CACHE
env.description: Optional SQLite cache toggle. Set to true or sqlite to enable.

env.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CACHE_PATH
env.description: Optional local SQLite cache path. Defaults to ~/.google-ads-mcp/cache.sqlite.

env.name: GOOGLE_ADS_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS
env.description: Optional cache TTL in seconds. Defaults to 60. Set to 0 to keep entries indefinitely (entries are still overwritten on each hit).

env.name: GOOGLE_ADS_NO_RETRY
env.description: Set to true to disable the HTTP retry middleware. Default false.
